unit_note: Corrected 2026-09-26. Paper Table 1 prints the header 'A (um^2/bit)', but the same paper plots the data in cm^2/bit: Fig. 3 (config memory) reaches ~1.2e-8 at LET 126 and Fig. 7 is labelled cm^2/bit with Kintex-7 near 1e-8. With A = 3.34e-8 cm^2/bit the Weibull gives sigma(126.1) = 1.17e-8, matching Fig. 3; so the printed header is a typo and A is already cm^2/bit. sigma_sat_cm2_per_bit = paper A as printed (no conversion). The earlier value 3.34e-12 was 1e4 too small (and did not even follow its own stated um^2 * 1e-8 rule). Cross-check: Lee Table 2 (GEO, solar min, 100 mil Al) 1.0e-7 /bit/day is only reproducible with the cm^2 reading.
orbit_seu_weibull_formula: sigma(L) = sigma_sat * (1 - exp(-((L - let_threshold)/width)^shape)), L > let_threshold else 0  (from orbit_seu/device.py WeibullLET)

param_mapping.sigma_sat_cm2_per_bit: paper A as printed (header says um^2/bit, data are cm^2/bit; see unit_note)
